steps.text: Bring a shovel and a rope.
Dig open the troll cave behind the tree east of the dwarf bridge and go down (trolls; slimes down the drain to the north).
steps.source: Go to the Troll cave east of the Dwarf Bridge (Mapper Coords 127.150, 124.222, 7). The cave entrance is hidden behind a tree. Be careful of the Slimes to the north of the cave entrance.

steps.text: Head south and go down the stairs (trolls).
steps.source: Once in the cave, head to the south and look for stairs down.

steps.text: Go north to the large room (trolls, a minotaur mage): the chest with a wooden doll, a wedding ring and a mirror.
steps.source: Once on the next level, head north. The quest boxes are on the north end of the large room.
The quest boxes are on the north end of the large room.
